info.name: 3JATA Organic Powder API (Backend Foundation)
info.description: Complete Backend Foundation collection covering Health, Authentication, RBAC & Staff, Categories/Products/Variants/Images, Inventory, and Negative/Security tests. Uses Postman Cookie Jar (3jata_sid + 3jata_csrf) and X-CSRF-Token header.

request.description: Public liveness check reporting server uptime and Mongoose connection state.
Returns 200 when MongoDB is connected, or 503 Service Unavailable if disconnected.
Public customer registration. Save verification token from newest file in backend/tmp/local-emails/ into {{verificationToken}}.
Consumes single-use verification token copied from local email preview.
Resends verification email (returns uniform 200 message to prevent account enumeration).
Logs in customer, sets HttpOnly 3jata_sid cookie and captures {{csrfToken}}.
Returns authenticated user profile and permissions using active session cookie.
Returns CSRF token bound to the current active session.
Changes password for authenticated user and revokes all active sessions.
Requests password reset email (anti-enumeration 200). Copy token from backend/tmp/local-emails/ into {{resetToken}}.
Resets password using single-use {{resetToken}} and revokes all active sessions.
Revokes current session in MongoDB and clears cookies.
Log in with the local owner account created via `npm run bootstrap:owner`. Enter your local password before sending.
Lists all active roles and their assigned permissions (requires roles.read). Captures product_manager ID into {{roleId}}.
Lists all system permissions (requires roles.read).
Owner provisions a new staff user (requires staff.create). Captures {{staffId}}.
Paginated staff listing (requires staff.read).
Fetches one staff account by {{staffId}} (requires staff.read).
Updates staff name (requires staff.update).
Reassigns staff role (requires roles.manage). Revokes target staff sessions.
Suspends staff user and revokes sessions (requires staff.update).
Reactivates suspended staff user (requires staff.update).
Paginated immutable audit trail (requires audit_logs.read).
Creates top-level category (requires categories.create). Captures {{categoryId}}.
Creates subcategory under {{categoryId}}. Captures {{subcategoryId}}.
Lists all categories including inactive/archived (requires categories.read).
Updates subcategory fields (requires categories.update).
Creates active product with integer-paise variants (requires products.create). Captures {{productId}} and {{variantId}}.

request.description: Lists drafts, active, and archived products including internalNotes (requires products.read).
Fetches full admin product view (requires products.read).
Updates product metadata/status (requires products.update).
Adds a 500g variant and initializes its Inventory at 0 (requires products.update).
Updates variant pricePaise/SKU/weight (requires products.update).
Uploads JPEG/PNG/WebP (max 2MB) to Cloudinary (requires products.update). Requires CLOUDINARY_* env vars. Captures {{imageId}}.
Deletes image owned by {{productId}} from Cloudinary and MongoDB.
Fetches current stock and last 10 movements for {{variantId}} (requires inventory.read).
Adds starting stock inside MongoDB transaction with required reason.
Records damaged stock deduction with negative quantityDelta.
Sets low-stock threshold for {{variantId}} (requires inventory.adjust).
Lists all variant stock records (requires inventory.read).
Lists variants where availableQuantity <= lowStockThreshold (requires inventory.read).
Lists immutable stock transactions with actor and timestamps (requires inventory.read).
Public active categories only.
Public category details + active subcategories.
Public active products only with variant availability.
Full public product details without internalNotes.
Non-destructively archives {{variantId}} (requires products.delete).
Non-destructively archives {{productId}} and its variants (requires products.delete).
Non-destructively archives {{subcategoryId}} after products are archived (requires categories.delete).
Non-destructively archives {{categoryId}} after children/products are archived.

item.name: NEG: Public Registration with Privileged Role (400)

request.description: Verifies public registration rejects role/isEmailVerified escalation fields.
Run after logout or clearing cookies; expects 401 Unauthorized.
Run while logged in as customer; expects 403 Forbidden.

item.name: NEG: Product Update Attempting Stock Modification (400)

request.description: Run while logged in as owner/PM; expects 400 rejecting forbidden stock field.

item.name: NEG: Inventory Adjustment Resulting in Negative Stock (400)

request.description: Run while logged in as owner/Inventory Manager; expects 400 rejecting negative stock.
Reuses previous Idempotency-Key with different quantityDelta; expects 409 Conflict.
